title: System coherence field (multi-seam couples)

claims.text: System coherence is a multi-seam coactivation score over blood, geometry, spectral, ranker, fusion, and hygiene — threshold 0.62; not consciousness.
Emergent coupling lights when enough couple indicators are active and score is above threshold; agents read emergence log first each turn.
Active couples include blood_geometry, geometry_learning, ops_geometry, gates_aligned, blood_learning, spectral_ops when co-moving telemetry allows.
